notes: A1: majority baseline and GBM (HGB early stopping on train holdout; val/test AUC reported; test evaluated once).
A2: local-only and pooled NN (train-std, val-AUC early stopping, single vs multi-task head grid, 3 seeds 42/43/44; class weighting skipped ~0.52 balance).
A3: in-process FedAvg+FedBN reference (~20 rounds), local epochs/lr chosen on validation grid (seed 42), 3 seeds 42/43/44, per-client local BN eval on own test split; validation curves recorded.

A4: isotonic calibration on validation predictions for federated reference (median seed) per client; Brier/ECE before/after, reliability diagrams, AUC unchanged up to ties; finalized summary/gap and shipped-model rule outcome.

summary.gate_note: 750-row test split => ~0.03 CI half-width typical; 'marginal' (point>=0.80, CI lower < 0.80) is common for good models; 'supported' means lower CI bound >= 0.80.
summary.shipped_model_rule_decision: Federated model meets >=0.80 point estimate for all clients (GBM also passes); no model-work escalation required by pre-registered miss rule. keep_5000 remains provisional pending broader evaluation.

calibration_comparison.description: Post-hoc calibration on federated reference model (per-client median seed from A3), fit on validation, evaluated on test. Brier-diff CIs from paired bootstrap (B=1000, seed=42); negative diff means improved Brier vs raw.

ship_decision.recommendation: No uniform calibration shipped. Platt scaling shows statistically supported Brier improvement for belgium_ageas and switzerland_helvetia (95% CI entirely below 0) with ECE reductions; isotonic/temperature/platt worsen Brier for germany_allianz and france_axa (CIs above or crossing 0 in unfavorable direction). AUC unchanged up to ties for temperature/platt; isotonic can change due to tie handling. Retain raw probabilities as shipped default; client-specific Platt calibration may be applied only with explicit per-client validation if needed.
ship_decision.note: Comparison computed on median-seed federated models (DE seed 42, FR/BE/CH seed 44).
